looks.emma: a 32-year-old woman with long straight auburn hair, pale skin with light freckles and green eyes, wearing a grey knit cardigan over a black top
looks.mark: a tall 42-year-old man with short black hair and a short trimmed black beard, sharp jaw, wearing a long black wool overcoat

style: Cinematic thriller film shot, night, dark moody low-key lighting, deep shadows, realistic, 35mm film

lines: Tonight, a dead man will try to save her life.

shots.v: A dark bedroom at night. {emma} is asleep in bed. On the nightstand a smartphone suddenly lights up and glows brightly, lighting the room. Static camera.
Close-up of {emma} lying in bed in a dark bedroom, she wakes up, slowly reaches for her glowing phone, the screen light on her sleepy face. Slow push-in.

lines: One new message. From her husband, Daniel. Who died exactly one year ago.

shots.v: {emma} sits up in bed in a dark bedroom staring at her phone in horror, her hand covering her mouth, trembling, the phone light on her face. Slow push-in.

lines: The number you have dialed is no longer in service.

shots.v: Flashback. A funeral in heavy rain at a grey cemetery. {mark} and other men in black carry a wooden coffin slowly, his face grim. Slow tracking shot.
lines: Mark. Daniel's older brother. The man who carried his coffin.

shots.v: Flashback. At a rainy cemetery under a black umbrella, {mark} hugs {emma} who is crying, he looks over her shoulder with a cold unreadable face. Slow push-in.
lines: I'm here now, Emma. Whatever you need. Always.

msgs: Check his laptop. Before he does.

shots.v: {emma} walks slowly down a dark wooden staircase at night holding her phone flashlight, looking around nervously. Camera follows her.
In a dark home office at night {emma} sits at a desk and opens a laptop, the bright screen lighting her tense face. Slow push-in.
lines: His password... still our wedding date.

shots.v: In a dark home office {emma} looks up startled as the lights suddenly go out, the room drops into darkness, only the laptop glow on her frightened face.
A dark house hallway at night seen from the far end, the front door at the end of the hall, a thin line of warm light under the door. Very slow push-in. No people.
lines: Three twenty-one a.m. The doorbell rang.

shots.v: {emma} creeps slowly along a dark hallway toward the front door holding her phone light, terrified, breathing fast. Camera follows behind her.
Night, a front porch under a single dim porch light. {mark} stands at the door, slowly raises a house key and smiles a cold, menacing smile at the camera. Slow push-in.
lines: Emma? I saw your light. Open up. It's just me.

shots.v: Extreme close-up of {emma} with her back against the inside of the front door in the dark, eyes wide with fear, whispering, her phone light on her face.
lines: I never gave you a key.

shots.v: Extreme close-up of a door lock at night, a metal key slides into the keyhole from outside and slowly turns, the door handle starts to move. Dark, moody.

msgs: Check his laptop. Before he does.

shots.v: Inside a dark hallway, the front door slowly creaks open, warm light spills in and a tall dark silhouette of a man stands in the doorway, {emma} backs away into the darkness.

lines: Would you open the door? Comment yes, or no. Part two drops in one hour.
